de: 125 Jahre Ski-Club Taunus: Als der Taunus noch ein Schneeparadies war. Pisten, Schanzen, Rennen: All das gab es auch einmal im Mittelgebirge. 125 Jahre nach seiner Gründung muss sich der Ski-Club Taunus nun neu positionieren. Er wird vom Schneesport- zum Outdoorverein.
en: 125 years of the Taunus Ski Club: When the Taunus was still a snow paradise. Slopes, jumps, races: all of this once existed in the low mountain ranges. 125 years after its founding, the Taunus Ski Club now has to reposition itself. It turns from a snow sports club into an outdoor club.
la: 125 annos Taunus Ski Club: Taunus adhuc erat paradisus nix. Proclivia, salit, saecla: haec quondam fuit in montibus imis. 125 annis post conditam, Taunus Ski Club nunc repositio se habet. Vertit ex nix ludis clava in clava velit.

en: Himalayas: Yellow snow on Everest. 6,000 liters of urine flow into the Everest base camp every day - researchers have now calculated how much glacier ice melts away as a result. The results fuel the old debate about how long the camp can still be used.
la: Himalayas: Crocus nix in Everest. 6000 liters urinae in castra Everestissima cottidie influunt - investigatores nunc computaverunt quantum glaciei glaciei sicut effectus liquescit. Eventus cibus disputatio antiqua est quomodo castra adhuc possunt adhiberi.
